challenge_tracks.name: Checkout Safety Track
challenge_tracks.sponsor_policy: Sponsors may fund course design but cannot weaken safety boundaries.

challenge_tracks.name: Browser Navigation Track
challenge_tracks.sponsor_policy: All challenge work stays public, read-only, and local-report oriented.

challenge_tracks.name: Observability Export Track
challenge_tracks.sponsor_policy: No observability keys, automatic logging, or network calls are used.

template_kits.name: Domain Edition Template
template_kits.purpose: Help humans copy the safe public playground pattern into a focused domain without adding accounts, private credentials, live checkout, hidden tracking, or external report collection.

observability_bridges.name: Local Observability Bridge
observability_bridges.safety: Agents may draft local JSON, but must not connect services, send reports, claim automatic logging happened, or include private data.

human_review.name: Human Report Review Run Book
human_review.purpose: Give humans a review path for checking local agent reports before gallery entries, badges, or public examples are approved.
human_review.safety: Agents may read the run book, but must not submit reports, publish examples, award badges, or claim human approval happened.

human_review.name: Report Intake Queue
human_review.purpose: Give humans local triage lanes for candidate reports before human review, redaction, evidence checks, gallery examples, or badges.
human_review.safety: Agents may read the queue template, but must not submit reports, move queue items, publish examples, award badges, or claim anything was stored.

planning_docs.name: Roadmap Status
planning_docs.purpose: Summarize branch scope, safety posture, verification checks, PR description draft, and the current GitHub DNS push blocker.
